neighbours.label: 'days' as a duration unit in code: the variable, keyword or key 'days' (days, hours = divmod(…), timedelta(days=days), ('days', …)) and neighbouring date identifiers; prose 'days' fires only weakly here
fire:
minutes, seconds = divmod(total, 60)
    hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)
    days, hours = divmod(hours, 24)

weeks, days = divmod(days, 7)
    return weeks, days
quiet:
minutes, seconds = divmod(total, 60)
    hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)

rows, cols = divmod(count, 7)
    return rows, cols

notes: Card: ' days' x6, Arabic ' يوم' x3, '.today' x2, 'days', '_DATE'; the + pole is singular ' day', so the neuron separates the unit 'days' from the single 'day'. Probes: 'days, hours = divmod' 0.73, "('days', 'Days')" 0.26, 'date.today().year' 0.14, prose 'within 5 days' 0.12, 'next day' 0.11, hours-only prose 0.02.
